zh: 昨天我和朋友出去吃了晚饭。
old_en: Yesterday, I ate out with a friend for dinner.
new_en: Yesterday, I went out to eat dinner with a friend.

zh: 今天加班太累了，出去吃饭放松一下。
old_en: I am too tired from working overtime today, so I am going to eat out to relax.
new_en: I am too tired from working overtime today, so let's go out to eat to relax.

zh: 上次出去吃饭时，我们吃了火锅。
old_en: Last time we ate out, we had hot pot.
new_en: Last time we ate out, we had hot pot.

zh: 记得那次出去吃饭，遇到了老朋友。
old_en: I remember when we ate out and ran into an old friend.
new_en: I remember eating out and running into an old friend.
